fields.gap: P2 equal-mass figure holds face separation at the row value while face thickness follows 1/rho. A changed face density moves tf and so moves separation by the same amount, a second-order change against 0.1-0.16 m cores.
fields.direction: Recompute E/rho with separation following tf if a candidate face material is far from 2700 kg/m3.
fields.effect: Small optimistic or pessimistic shift in the P2 buckling figure for extreme densities.
